# Dataset panel: unpublished cells, revisions, covariates

**September 28 update:** the default panel now spans May 14, 2022–September 19, 2026 and includes 2022–23 for training. [Coverage and verification](../results/dataset-2022-extension/index.md). The tables below describe the preceding September 22 build.


Generated by `python -m tapestry.dataset.analyze_dataset --dataset data/processed/panel.npz` (rerun after every panel rebuild). All numbers and figures are computed from the panel; definitions are in the module docstring and below. Design: [unified restructuring §3](../design/restructure-2026-unified.md).

## Panel

- file: `data/processed/panel.npz`, sha256 `3e12481cb04b189f44d6315f0790682a37a74659569af7f8aae2f7fba2e23b89`, 10.8 MB
- build: version 4, truth day 2026-09-22, calendar 2023-09-02 to 2026-09-19
- dimensions: 160 Saturdays x 52 locations x 6 targets; 13 state covariates, 1 national covariate(s)
- issuances: 160 Wednesdays, 2023-08-30 to 2026-09-16; 153 vintaged episodes kept (lookback = asof_weeks = 9)
- raw snapshots: `delphi_claims_inpatient` 20260916T142718.964296Z, `delphi_claims_outpatient` 20260916T142831.880328Z, `delphi_flusurv` 20260922T204051.916853Z, `delphi_fluview_clinical` 20260922T204051.880663Z, `delphi_fluview_ilinet` 20260922T204051.781844Z, `delphi_nhsn` 20260916T142715.158100Z, `delphi_nssp` 20260916T142717.398812Z, `derived_nwss_state_indices` 20260922T170917.373373Z, `hub_covid_current` 20260917T132454.400755Z, `hub_flusight_current` 20260917T132413.278230Z, `hub_rsv_current` 20260917T132503.803731Z, `pophive_kinsa_ili` 20260921T161214.502587Z

## 1. Unpublished cells in vintaged episodes

User decision 2026-09-22 (later): in vintaged mode, a target cell in the as-of window with nothing visible at the Wednesday cutoff is **unavailable** (`available=False`), not filled with final truth. This section measures how many cells that is. j = weeks before issuance: j = 0 is the context end (Saturday four days before the Wednesday). Share = unpublished cells / cells that exist at all (visible at the cutoff or present in the final truth), the same denominator the earlier truth fallback used, so these numbers are comparable with the previous page. A missing archive and a not-yet-reported week both count. The default `asof_weeks=2` uses j = 0 and 1 only; larger `asof_weeks` use more columns.

## 4. Covariates in US and NC

Final (truth-day) values, each divided by its own maximum at that location over the calendar. Colour = pathogen, line style = source (solid inpatient claims, dashed outpatient claims, dotted NWSS wval_like, dash-dot NWSS pct_rank; Kinsa purple; ILINet ILI brown; long dashes clinical-lab influenza percent positive; dash-dot-dot FluSurv-NET rate). Faint dots: the context-end week of each Wednesday issuance as visible at its cutoff, same scale (the latest as-of value an episode sees). A covariate with no value at a location is listed in the legend as not available.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

## 5. Wastewater indices (NWSS)

The two indices per pathogen, `wval_like` and `pct_rank`, from the `derived_nwss_state_indices` snapshot (rebuilt by `python -m tapestry.dataset.build nwss-indices`; definitions in [wastewater](wastewater.md)). Lines: final (truth-day) value per week; dots: the context-end week as visible at each Wednesday cutoff (NaN before the first Delphi archive vintage, 2026-02-25). Weeks with any value: 2023-09-02 to 2026-09-19; plotted range restricted to it. States need at least 3 eligible sites.
